blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A Mindanao-based civil society organization is calling for an immediate halt to hostilities between Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthi movement, urging both sides to reconcile and redirect Muslim solidarity toward the Palestinian cause. In a statement on Sunday, the Moro Consensus Group (MCG) appealed directly to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni Ansar Allah (supporters of God) fighters — commonly known as the Houthis — to pursue lasting peace and end internal strife among Muslims. “The continued conflict in Yemen brings unnecessary suffering to Muslim brethren and weakens the collective strength of the Ummah,” […]...
